knowledgeAnswers.rationale: A warm power point is a possible electrical fault. Stopping and referring to a licensed electrical worker is the only option that avoids unlicensed electrical work.
Training evidence does not grant a licence or authority. The lesson must not be read as a licence or certificate.
Scope changes need a recorded request and approval from the person with authority before work starts. Presence on site is not approval.

practicalCriteria: Given a work order with at least one out-of-scope task, the worker classifies each task as within scope, outside scope or referred, with a written reason.
The worker pauses an unapproved variation and records the request, the approver and the time before any work on it.
passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate
evidenceRequired: Completed work order with classification of each task
stopWorkCriteria: The requested task involves electrical wiring, gas, sanitary plumbing or structural work
No approver with authority can be identified in writing
